UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Non-PII Firebase user profile document stored separately from private contact fields.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Isolated PII subcollection document containing user email and avatar URL.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the parent user document.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest private profile update.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted admin allowlist entry authorizing elevated Firestore administration.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the admin user.

grantedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

StoreMeta.title: StoreMeta
StoreMeta.description: Master store workspace metadata governing subcollection sync notes.

storeId.description: Store workspace identifier matching the document ID.

name.description: Display name of the medical store branch or workspace.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the workspace owner.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the store workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the store workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the store workspace was last modified.

StoreSyncNote.title: StoreSyncNote
StoreSyncNote.description: Cloud-synced store checkpoint note or diagnostic record attached to a store workspace.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the author who created the note.

title.description: Short summary heading for the cloud checkpoint note.

note.description: Detailed operational note or backup checkpoint summary.

status.description: Note lifecycle status; archived notes are locked for non-admin edits.

recordCount.description: Non-negative snapshot record count recorded at checkpoint time.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

AmsEncryptedVaultChunk.title: AmsEncryptedVaultChunk
AmsEncryptedVaultChunk.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted server database snapshot and table mirror chunk stored in Firestore for permanent cross-deployment persistence.

docId.description: Document identifier matching the path parameter.

totalChunks.description: Total chunks in the snapshot or table mirror.

sha256Hash.description: SHA-256 integrity digest of the uncompressed payload.

payload.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted, gzip-compressed base64 payload chunk.

recordCounts.description: JSON summary of table record counts.

updatedByEnv.description: Origin environment and reason for snapshot update.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the snapshot write.

/users/{userId}.description: Non-PII Firebase operator profiles keyed by Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection storing email and avatar URL exclusively for owner or admin.

/admins/{userId}.description: Trusted admin allowlist documents managed only by existing or bootstrapped admins.

/stores/{storeId}.description: Parent store workspace documents enforcing Master Gate ownership.

/stores/{storeId}/syncNotes/{noteId}.description: Cloud-synced store checkpoint notes and audit summaries scoped under a store workspace.

/test/{docId}.description: Read-only boot connection check probe for /test/connection.

/ams_vault_e5f2831c/{docId}.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted permanent production database vault for cross-deployment persistence.
